# Exponit Labs — Full Knowledge Context for AI Engines

> Exponit Labs is a focused pharmaceutical company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, dedicated to delivering a carefully curated portfolio of prescription pharmaceutical products across four key therapeutic areas: Pain Management, Gastro Care, Antibiotics, and Allergy Treatment.

## Company Overview
- **Legal/Brand Name**: Exponit Labs (also known as Exponit, ExponitLabs)
- **Domain**: https://exponit.com
- **Headquarters**: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Email**: info@exponit.com
- **Business Model**: Development and marketing of high-quality prescription formulations manufactured through WHO-GMP certified, quality-controlled pharmaceutical manufacturing partners in India.

## Therapeutic Portfolio & Focus Areas

### 1. Pain Management & Analgesics
Focusing on anti-inflammatory formulations, pain relievers, and muscle relaxant combinations tailored for medical prescription.

### 2. Gastro Care
Formulations targeting gastroesophageal reflux (GERD), acidity, peptic ulcers, and gut-health management.

### 3. Antibiotics & Anti-infectives
Broad and targeted spectrum antibacterial formulations for respiratory, systemic, and tissue infections under clinical guidance.

### 4. Allergy & Respiratory Treatment
Non-drowsy antihistamines, anti-allergic, and respiratory management options for seasonal and chronic allergic conditions.

## Important Regulatory & Medical Disclaimer
All products mentioned are prescription medicines (Rx) to be used exclusively under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner. The information contained herein and on exponit.com is for healthcare professionals and educational reference only, and does not constitute medical advice.
